summary: Tested all 5 new features: app rename to BookMyEvents, gate codes (BME011103/MME011103), Phone OTP login UI, manager endpoints, public pages (privacy policy, T&C, delete-account). 9/10 backend tests pass. All frontend flows verified.

The /api/ route works correctly and returns {message: 'BookMyEvents API'}. Consider moving health check to /api/health or accepting this as a proxy routing limitation.
